body.brief: REDESIGN the Maddie cognitive infrastructure API + UI based on Loop 1 findings. HARD CONSTRAINTS from elder review: (1) NO chatbot turns, NO utterance/message box, NO submit button — interaction is a single always-on RECORD button; raw audio segments stream in continuously when recording is on. (2) NO processing/loading spinners — silent ingest, async backend. (3) Default-OFF inheritance policy: vault is sealed at subject death; the subject must EXPLICITLY designate per-story access for each named family member while alive. No global access grant. (4) Eight Maddie sub-agents (librarian, narrator, fact-checker, timeline-keeper, relationship-mapper, tone-monitor, intake-greeter, export-curator) operate behind the surface and never expose themselves to the user. (5) Witness-attest every state change per CP §10. UI is single-page HTML, phone-friendly, 18pt+ type, the BIG button is the only required affordance. Implementer sub-agents will follow — produce specs sharp enough to build from.
body.output_text:
# Maddie Cognitive Infrastructure API Redesign

## Endpoints

### `/ingest/audio-stream` [POST]
- Scope: `maddie:ingest:raw`
- Input: Continuous audio stream (multipart/form-data)
- Output: 
```json
{"attestation_id": "uuid", "segment_id": "uuid", "timestamp": "ISO8601"}
```

### `/vault/access-policy` [PUT]
- Scope: `maddie:vault:admin`
- Input:
```json
{
  "story_id": "uuid",
  "beneficiary": {"email": "string", "relationship": "enum"},
  "access_level": "enum"
}
```

### `/query/timeline` [GET]
- Scope: `maddie:query:timeline`
- Parameters: `?start=ISO8601&end=ISO8601`
- Output:
```json
{
  "events": [
    {
      "timestamp": "ISO8601", 
      "summary": "string",
      "attestation_chain": ["uuid"]
    }
  ]
}
```

## Auth
- JWT with scopes: `maddie:ingest:raw`, `maddie:vault:admin`, `maddie:query:timeline`
- Refresh tokens disabled
- 15m session expiry

## Permission Scopes
| Scope | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `maddie:ingest:raw` | Audio stream ingestion |
| `maddie:vault:admin` | Modify access policies |
| `maddie:query:timeline` | Read timeline events |

## Error Shape
```json
{
  "error": "short_code",
  "attestation_required": true|false,
  "valid_scopes": ["string"]
}
```

## Witness Attestation Surface
- All state changes return `attestation_id` in response
- Chain verifiable via `/attestation/{id}` [GET]
- Required fields:
```json
{
  "timestamp": "ISO8601",
  "actor": "jwt_sub",
  "pre_state_hash": "sha256",
  "post_state_hash": "sha256"
}
```

## UI Constraints
- Single HTML page with:
  - 18pt minimum font
  - Full-screen RECORD button (300px minimum touch target)
  - No other interactive elements
  - Audio visualization only during recording
- All API calls:
  - Silent (no spinners)
  - Async with queueing
  - Failures trigger single toast notification

[IMPLEMENTATION BOUNDARY: Sub-agents handle all processing. No chatbot interface permitted.]
